searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — limitless revelation the awtsmoos is beyond route, class, pixel, branch, stone, leaf, creature, and world; awtsmoos.com may still become a vessel where every visible surface is calm and every hidden depth opens only when intention asks for more. product vision every route is mobile first, visually calm, futuristic, fast, and locally styled. primary actions remain visible; advanced actions retract into details, drawers, sheets, inspectors, command palettes, and contextual menus. no route global css. shared components opt in through explicit component roots. no arbitrary z index ladders. every route owns a semantic bounded layer scale. every interactive control has meaningful hover, focus visible, active, disabled, selected/open/busy/error states. motion uses transform/opacity where possible, disappears gracefully for reduced motion, and never blocks interaction. no fixed/sticky surface exists without explicit content clearance and safe area handling. every async ui state becomes first class: idle, loading, empty, success, partial, error, offline, retrying, cancelled. every route has a tiny boot file, focused state/domain authorities, transport adapters, views, and tests. every public api is simple at the surface and data driven underneath. every touched js file is fully documented, modular, tab indented, readable, and free of anonymous compressed logic. social network ideal one identity/session truth drives profile, follow graph, discovery, inbox, messages, chat, spaces, privacy, activity, and realtime. follow state converges across every surface immediately and safely. search cancels stale work and labels result kinds explicitly. inbox events use stable typed records and derived unread state. messages expose only delivery/read/presence semantics actually proven by backend evidence. realtime has one transport owner, bounded reconnect, dedupe, and visible connection truth. composer drafts, media, comments, replies, transformations, and retries have explicit operation state. mobile social keeps primary navigation reachable while advanced routes live in a focus safe retractable sheet. procedural core ideal one simple data api manifests rocks, trees, grass, flowers, creatures, materials, textures, and biome compositions. seeds are deterministic and child stream based so generation order never changes unrelated results. geometry generation remains separate from three.js manifestation where current seams permit. remote textures support timeout, abort, cache ownership, fallback generation, channel maps, uv transforms, color space hints, and disposal. rocks become geology: morphology, strata, erosion, fracture, weathering, field placement, and quality tiers. trees become developmental graphs: trunk/branch topology, taper, crown strategy, leaves, wind metadata, sockets, lod. grass becomes instancing ready ecology with density fields, terrain alignment, variation, wind, and biome recipes. flowers separate plant anatomy from cluster ecology. creatures separate anatomy graph, proportions, skeleton, covering, sockets, movement metadata, and renderer manifestation. existing public apis remain compatible while the new surface becomes simpler. all pages home → apps → social → docs → drive → authoring → heichel → profile/auth → messages/media → games → os/admin → utilities/legal → procedural demos/docs. every route receives discovery, architecture, full file rewrite only where evidence proves debt, static verification, behavior tests, browser verification where available, documentation, and a durable delta.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — realistic architecture the awtsmoos gives chesed the horizon and gevurah the border; awtsmoos.com must strengthen the living codebase rather than replace proven contracts with a fashionable second universe. chosen architecture social preserve the existing domain panels and api foundation. split cross cutting orchestration first: focused assembly modules initialization coordinator identity transition coordinator context presenter route/live coordinators remain authoritative where already proven only introduce shared relationship/operation models after multiple concrete panels prove duplicated state vocabulary. pages use explicit route roots and local manifests. shared component css must be opt in and importer mapped before editing. large route files split by responsibility, never by shaving comments. procedural core do not create procedural v2. extend existing natureapi, domem/tzomayach authorities, materials, animalmesh, recipe, terrain, and runtime seams. normalize inputs at boundaries, preserve exports, and add compatibility tests. first production file families 1. social lifecycle and assembly. 2. social network/profile/people relationship convergence. 3. social discovery/search cancellation and pagination. 4. inbox/messages/realtime truth. 5. composer/media/comment resilience. 6. social docs + ui/browser proof. 7. procedural nature api/material contract. 8. rock/tree/grass/flower/creature realism. 9. docs/drive remaining route debt. 10. remaining route family sweep. non goals no framework migration. no fake backend capabilities. no ornamental inheritance. no blanket overflow:hidden to conceal broken layout. no global css shortcuts. no shared file edits before importer mapping. no speculative public contract breaks.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase three — critique and final plan the awtsmoos renews the plan before the plan can become a throne; awtsmoos.com therefore turns every attractive abstraction back toward evidence, tests, and the user visible road. thirty failure prevention improvements 1. read full target files before rewrite. 2. trace exports and outside call sites first. 3. preserve createsocialhub(root) and direct app property consumers. 4. keep route coordinator authoritative for route loading. 5. keep one realtime transport owner. 6. add identity generations only where stale async completion is demonstrable. 7. report partial social reload failure honestly. 8. never equate unknown relationship state with false. 9. optimistic follow requires rollback snapshot. 10. search debounce never substitutes for abort/cancellation. 11. pagination rejects stale mode/query pages. 12. inbox unread derives from typed records when possible. 13. message semantics never exceed backend evidence. 14. realtime dedupe requires stable ids or explicit composite keys. 15. draft persistence is bounded and identity aware. 16. media state distinguishes cancellation, validation, transport, and server rejection. 17. mobile sheets restore focus. 18. every fixed surface reserves space. 19. semantic layer tokens remain route local. 20. pointer hover motion is capability gated. 21. reduced motion preserves state clarity. 22. new js authorities receive focused tests. 23. new procedural seeds use named child streams. 24. remote texture cache ownership/disposal is explicit. 25. procedural recursion/subdivision is quality budget bounded. 26. semantic creature sockets survive quality tiers. 27. generated materials fail soft with deterministic fallback. 28. every touched file gets full readback and indentation/minification scans. 29. planned vs actual delta becomes remaining work. 30. browser limitations are reported as limitations, never invented proof. exact immediate next action read current social state/navigation/route/realtime/assembly/lifecycle files and constructor signatures in small batches. then rewrite the first social lifecycle/assembly wave as complete files. code first, tests second. after proof, move into relationship convergence, then procedural core api/material foundations.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he ui chesed — clean futuristic observatory the awtsmoos renews the visible vessel before the eye can call it interface; awtsmoos.com should reveal enormous capability through calm hierarchy, air, and grace. product intent the observatory is an expert instrument, not the human social network itself. the ui must make that distinction obvious while remaining inviting: one primary path into social hub, one compact expert workspace, advanced context only when requested, safe reads visually dominant, mutations visibly guarded, exact evidence retractable. visual obligations scope every observatory selector beneath .social hub document. no bare .hub selector may remain in the observatory style modules. no 100vw, fixed content widths, accidental horizontal overflow, or uncontrolled preformatted blocks. keep the existing dark professional palette but increase depth through restrained surfaces, not decorative noise. use mobile first layout and progressive desktop enhancement. preserve 44–48px touch targets. add hover only for hover capable pointers; add :active for actual press feedback everywhere relevant. keep :focus visible high contrast and separate from hover. respect reduced motion and forced colors. avoid high z index escalation; presence remains a bounded separate component. ux obligations make request context retractable with native semantics. summary must explain that context changes inspection, not data. keep all five fields reachable and labeled when expanded. make the human destination read “open social hub”, not the more ambiguous “interaction studio”. show semantic capability reality in the hero: 27 safe reads and 5 guarded actions. keep explore current panel as the primary action and explore all reads as secondary. keep raw api evidence under advanced disclosure. keep mutations in a separate act region with explicit consequence language. next action write the gevurah ownership map, then the tiferes final file plan before changing markup or css.
